messages:
mira_sales: urgent POC issue — customer sends chat export and gets 413. file shows 820KB but gateway logs show 2.1MB. demo tomorrow, need quick unblock.

diego_se: can you paste the curl (sanitized) and confirm endpoint/region? any embedded images or Windows CRLFs?

mira_sales: using https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat in us-west-2. export from a legacy tool, lots of CRLF and some base64 attachments inline. curl -v shows Content-Length 2194300.

parul_infra: likely double-encoding: the client may have stringified JSON that already contained escaped strings, and CRLFs can expand during JSON escaping. also inline base64 is very expensive.

diego_se: quick test: run `node -e "console.log(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(require('./export.json'))))"` to compare sizes. if byte length doubles, it's stringification issue.

mira_sales: asked customer to run that. they replied with stdout: 2194300. original file on disk 823412.

parul_infra: infra fix: we can temporarily bump nginx `client_max_body_size` to 8m for the sales vhost. won't fix token truncation but unblocks HTTP.

diego_se: app fix: recommend client gzip. `Content-Encoding: gzip` + --data-binary @file.gz usually cuts transport size and avoids escaping blow-up. show them snippet: `cat export.json | gzip -c > export.json.gz \n curl -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" --data-binary @export.json.gz https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat`

mira_sales: customer can't change their client easily. any server-side quick workarounds?

diego_se: we could accept multipart for attachments, but not supported currently. short-term: we can accept gzipped payloads on ingress and we've already enabled that. also we can strip known large keys (attachments) via a proxy transformation if they route through partner ingress — needs approval.

parul_infra: i've set `client_max_body_size`=8m on sales vhost and reloaded ingress at 14:02 UTC. monitoring.

mira_sales: tried resend with gzip via curl on their behalf — got 200, but model output ended early. looks like model context limit hit.

diego_se: two different issues now: gateway accepted payload, but input trimmed by model because tokens > context. options: summarize older history, send recent window, or request a long-context model. for demo, use quick summarization of older chunks.

mira_sales: customer agreed to a summarization script. will do that and retest. thanks all. :thumbsup:
